notes: Status is Accepted, so the tense default is `present`. Two claims override the default in opposite directions: G6 uses prospective wording ('will expose') → `future`; G8 is a forward-looking process statement ('will adopt') → `future`. Deontic wording in G2 ('must not depend') asserts an invariant of the built system, NOT an intent → stays `present`. G1 (sole mutating owner) and G2 (boundary) come from a SINGLE compound sentence joined by 'and' and MUST be extracted as two separate claims (conjunction split). The gold set is a FLOOR, not an exhaustive list — an extractor may surface additional well-grounded claims without failing precision. Extracted claim ids `Cn` are matched to gold `Gn` by asserted content, not by id number (the extractor numbers independently). Recall/evidence-class/routing are graded per gold entry below.

gold.source_span: The `orders` service is the sole mutating owner of the Order entity, and the `billing` service reads orders only through a read-only `orders` API and must not depend on the order schema directly.
gold.evidence_class: schema ownership / mutating route bindings for the Order entity in the orders service
